rule: S203 (P-13) — every workflow a second human would walk is EXECUTED and committed as a transcript, FAILURE PATHS included (X-SHOWN(b)). The authoring is AGENT-labeled; realLineageCount stays 0 (an agent proves the door opens, never that a stranger walked it — A′#4). The terminal state is READY-UNVERIFIED-BY-A-SECOND-HUMAN.

workflows.name: first-run (offline Reality Check)
workflows.happyPath: the fixture renders (status 200); every UNJUDGEABLE carries why + path (S199)
workflows.failurePath: a nonexistent manifest id → status 404, an honest degrade (SAMPLE/empty), never a crash

workflows.name: capture (RPC read)
workflows.happyPath: served by llamarpc, provider recorded per-point (S201)
workflows.failurePath: UNREACHABLE{attempts:4, lastError} — nothing chained, the point is UNREACHABLE not REAL★

workflows.name: backfill (resume + dedupe)
workflows.happyPath: CHAINED then DEDUPED on re-walk (idempotent — the same block twice does not fork the moat, DD-96)
workflows.failurePath: a same-block-different-value CONFLICT is a loud HALT, never silently resolved

workflows.name: socket (MCP-over-stdio negotiation)
workflows.happyPath: in-range version accepted (2025-11-25); stdio only, NO listener/port/daemon
workflows.failurePath: out-of-range version REFUSED, naming the supported range [2024-11-05, 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25]

workflows.name: contagion score (dependency map)
workflows.happyPath: two positions → a shared-dependency count (never counsel)
workflows.failurePath: one position → UNJUDGEABLE (a count needs ≥2), never silently "independent"

workflows.name: author-to-the-brink (AGENT-quarantined)
workflows.happyPath: the authoring door OPENS (the strategy layer accepts a manifest to its brink); a zero-observation strategy renders INSUFFICIENT with its path: "INSUFFICIENT clears to GO when the observed length exceeds MinTRL AND …"
workflows.failurePath: the door is walked by the AGENT only — realLineageCount stays 0, IN2 (the first REAL manifest) is the Operator's; the transcript proves the MACHINERY, never a stranger's footprint (RP-6/A′#4)

summary: 6 workflows executed, all ran=true, all failure-paths exercised=true; 3 AGENT-labeled; realLineageCount 0 (BY DESIGN)
